title: Enter (a documented fire key) opens the Nexus in the middle of a Trial of Six boss fight
steps: Seed a Lv 25 save (pixeltown-save-v1 realm.level 25), open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&seed=12345 (desktop 1280x720)
Walk to the Nexus, press Enter to go in, walk to the Trial of Six gate, press E
The trial starts and the boss (Inferno Wyrm) wakes right next to the Nexus portal; the hero stands on the Nexus site and the 'Visit the Nexus (Enter)' pill is shown under the hero
Fire with Enter (the HUD hint says 'Space / Enter fire')
expected: During a trial fight Enter only fires; the Nexus prompt is hidden while the rush is on (or the boss spawns away from the portal).
actual: First Enter press opens the Nexus walk screen over the fight (w.nexus.isOpen() true, arena paused, rush.state().phase still 'fight', boss still alive). Esc closes it and the fight resumes. Accidental for a keyboard player, and a free pause/escape hatch for a hardcore one.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js:1987 (Enter -> nexusOpen() has no rush/boss check; 1995 keeps showing the prompt)

title: Door gaps have no corner-slip: approaching an open door 9+ px off-centre stops the hero dead on the frame
steps: Open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=dungeon&biome=meadow&seed=7 (1280x720), stay in the start room
Stand ~90 px in front of the open W (or E/N) door, 9 px or more off the door's centre line
Hold A (straight into the door) for 1 s
expected: The hero slides into the 1-tile door gap (common top-down corner nudge) and enters the next room.
actual: Offsets 0 and 6 px enter; 9, 11, 14, 18 px all stop against the frame (x=51 for the W door, x=629 for E) and never enter (the enter trigger is d < 22 px from the door tile centre). My play bot got stuck the same way at the N door at 10 px off. Players must wiggle to line up every door.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/dungeon.js:863 (open door needs d < 22) + realm.js player wall collision (no slide toward the gap)

title: 'New best tier' toast covers the boss name and HP bar during dungeon boss fights (and the 'defeated' banner on phones)
steps: Fresh save, open ?mode=dungeon&biome=meadow (desktop) or &biome=warren (phone 390x844)
Clear rooms so a gear bag gives a higher tier than before, then walk into the boss room
expected: Loot toasts never sit on the boss bar; they queue or sit lower/aside during a boss fight.
actual: The toast 'New best tier: T6 Bloom Staff' sits exactly on 'The Mire Queen · phase 1' and its HP bar for 4.5 s at the start of the fight. On phone it also stacks over the minimap and, after the kill, over 'Queen Burrowmole defeated! The portal opens.' (three layers at the top).

title: Phone dungeon boss fight: the boss bar overlaps the minimap and the mutator chip
steps: Phone 390x844 touch, open ?mode=dungeon&biome=crypt&seed=31&lv=2
Walk to the boss room (Lich King)
expected: Boss bar, minimap and mutator chip each have their own space.
actual: Measured rects: boss bar 69..321 x 100..136, minimap 280..380 x 124..214, mutator chip '✦ Swift' 62..127 x 120..145. The chip covers the left end of the boss HP bar and the minimap covers its right end.

title: Phone portrait: the 2x2 ability buttons and both sticks cover the lower third of the dungeon room, where bullets and the S door are
steps: Phone 390x844, any dungeon room, e.g. Lich King boss room above
expected: Play area not under controls (the page has ~200 px of empty space above the room).
actual: The canvas is 389x506 starting at y=215; the four ability buttons (248..372 x 560..685) sit on top of the room's right-bottom quarter and the sticks on its bottom edge; boss bullets fly under them. Above the room sit ~100 px of stacked HUD. After a boss kill the floor-choice card also lands on the ability buttons.

title: Desktop: the Q/E/R/F ability bar hides the bottom-centre S door tile, the hero who enters through it, and secret cracks on that wall
steps: 1280x720, ?mode=dungeon&biome=bramble&seed=77, take the first door
The hero enters through a S door (bottom centre)
expected: Hero and door tiles always visible.
actual: The hero spawns at ~(640,630) completely behind the ability bar (514..766 x 628..688) and the key hint line; the S door and a cracked (secret) S wall tile (meadow seed 100 start room) are hidden under it too, so the secret is hard to spot.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.css (ability bar over the fixed 17x13 room; room canvas is not shrunk above it)

title: ?floor=3 is accepted straight from the URL: a fresh Lv 1 save gets floor-3 (T10/T11) boss loot without clearing floors 1-2
steps: Fresh save, open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=dungeon&biome=crypt&seed=555&lv=2&floor=3
Clear to the boss and kill it, take the portal
expected: Floors 2/3 only reachable from the stairs of the run (the code comment says 'only from the deep-run stairs'), or the URL floor is validated against a run token.
actual: HUD chip '✦ Mirror · Floor 3', summary 'Floor 3 of 3', loot T10 Bounce Stars, T11 Dread Jerkin, T11 Helix Staff for a Lv 1 hero (same seed floor 1 gives T8/T9). Reloading the floor-3 page also re-rolls the floor for another boss bag.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:132 (floor from params.get('floor') with no check) / dungeon.js:793

title: Entering a boss room through the N door puts the hero under the boss bar
steps: 1280x720, deep run crypt seed 107 floor 2 (Bone Colossus), boss room entered from the N door
actual: The hero spawns at ~(640,70), half hidden behind 'The Bone Colossus · phase 1' bar (460..820 x 70..106) just as the fight starts.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.css (#realm-boss top over the room's top door row)

title: Trial of Six fights happen in the open starter zone at the Nexus; wandering world mobs and their bullets join the boss fight
steps: Lv 25 save, start the Trial of Six from the Nexus gate (desktop and phone)
expected: A boss rush reads as its own arena (or at least world mobs are cleared/held off while it runs).
actual: Inferno Wyrm spawns at the Nexus in 'Shore · Safe-ish' with shore mobs, their purple bullets and a 'Raid in 1:01 · Highlands' timer all on screen; on desktop the boss first appears partly under the step banner and the top edge. On phone the zone line, boss bar, raid timer and minimap stack in the top 200 px.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js rush start (boss placed at the Nexus site)

title: Falling in the Trial gives the generic world fall line, no Trial result
steps: Lv 25 save with the starter wand, start the Trial, die to boss 1
expected: A short Trial result (reached step 1 of 6, bosses beaten 0, drops kept).
actual: Only 'You fell in the Realm… no 💎 lost — cache: Common Hearty Charm · in Shore, 0 kills, +0 💎 this run'. rush.state().phase becomes 'fell' silently; nothing tells the player the Trial ended or how far they got.

title: Trial of Six gate has no art (plain ring) and the walk route to it snags on the Quest Giver
steps: Lv 25 save, enter the Nexus (walk view, 1280x720), walk east toward the 'Trial of Six' label
expected: An original gate sprite like the portals; NPCs do not block the obvious straight route.
actual: MMNexus.layout().trial has art:null and is drawn as a flat yellow ring. Walking straight right from the entrance the hero stops on the Quest Giver (prompt switches to 'Quest board: Quest Giver (E)'); a second route stopped near the Lantern vault. Label 'Smith' clipped at the left edge (known).

title: Boss HP does not grow from floor 2 to floor 3, and can drop from floor 1 to floor 2
steps: Open ?mode=dungeon&biome=crypt&seed=107&lv=2 and take the stairs twice; note boss maxHp each floor
Same with biome=meadow&seed=100
expected: Each deeper floor is at least as hard as the one above.
actual: Crypt: floor 1 Lich King 612, floor 2 Bone Colossus 260 (Brittle), floor 3 Lich King 612. Meadow: Mire Queen 192, 546, 546. Floor 3 = floor 2 in both; crypt floor 2 is the easiest boss of the run.
suspect: game/shared/mm-difficulty.js dungeonScale (floor term) / boss pick per floor

title: R (universal Restart) does nothing on the dungeon fall summary, and there is no same-seed 'Try again'
steps: 1280x720, ?mode=dungeon&biome=crypt&seed=31&lv=2, walk into the Lich King and fall
On 'You fell in the Crypt' press R
expected: CONTROLS.md: R restarts from a game-over screen (here: retry the same dungeon, or at least 'New dungeon').
actual: R does nothing (URL, room 6 and arena state 'dead' unchanged after 2.5 s). The only buttons are 'New dungeon' (seed 32, a different layout) and 'Back to the map' (hub). Retrying the same seed needs a URL edit.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/dungeon.js:745 (summary buttons; no key handler for R / pad Back)

title: Dungeon fall shows the world banner 'You fell in the Realm… wave 1, 0 kills' before the Crypt summary
steps: Fall in any dungeon room (crypt seed 31 boss room)
expected: Dungeon wording (the crypt, rooms; no waves).
actual: For ~2.5 s the big banner reads 'You fell in the Realm… no 💎 lost — cache: Common Hearty Charm · wave 1, 0 kills, +0 💎 this run' over the boss, then the correct 'You fell in the Crypt' card fades in. 'wave' means nothing in a dungeon.
suspect: game/realm.js death banner text (world wording also used in dungeon mode)
